description: This file defines utility functions and constants related to NetworkManager for GNOME, including device property retrieval, interface status checks, and persistent hostname management.

classes.name: nmUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for network interface properties, security modes, frequency, and persistent hostname handling.

methods.name: getDeviceProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of network devices (implementation not shown).

methods.name: deviceHostname
methods.description: Gets the device hostname from persistent storage.

methods.name: convertPercentageToSignalStrength
methods.description: Converts a percentage value to a Wi-Fi signal strength value.

methods.name: wifiSecurityModeFromAp
methods.description: Determines Wi-Fi security mode based on AP flags.

methods.name: wifiFrequencyFromAp
methods.description: Converts frequency value from AP info to MHz.

methods.name: getSecurityModeString
methods.description: Returns a string description of the security mode based on flags.

methods.name: setNetworkManagerlogLevelToTrace
methods.description: Sets NetworkManager logging level to trace for detailed logging.

methods.name: setMarkerFile
methods.description: Creates or removes a marker file at the specified path.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is enabled.

methods.name: writePersistentHostname
methods.description: Writes the hostname to persistent storage.

methods.name: readPersistentHostname
methods.description: Reads the hostname from persistent storage.
